name: What are the common signs of a collapsed sewer line?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a collapsed sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a collapsed sewer line include recurring clogs or backups in multiple drains, gurgling sounds from toilets or drains, sewage odors in or around your property, slow drains, and lush, green patches in your yard or indentations on your lawn. You might also notice standing water in your yard or a sudden increase in your water bill due to leaks. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent further damage and more extensive repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include recurring clogs, gurgling drains, sewage odors, slow drainage, and unusually green or sunken spots in your yard.
